faq1Q: How do I register for a session?
faq1A: Use the form above (subject “Session registration”) or contact your CFAO representative. We confirm the seat, dates and logistics within 2 business days.
faq2Q: How do I get a brand PDF catalogue?
faq2A: 2026 catalogues are on the Training page and from the home page (brand cards). Switch the site to EN for English PDF versions where available.
faq3Q: Do I need a learner account to register?
faq3A: Not for a first request. The Academy team creates your portal access after your branch or network contact validates the registration.
faq4Q: Do you offer Equipment certifications (LOVOL, JCB…)?
faq4A: Yes — in-person sessions on machinery and forklifts, with manufacturer level 1 certification. Check the Equipment planner or contact us for an in-network session.
faq5Q: Where do sessions take place and is travel covered?
faq5A: At the Academy centre (Douala, etc.), at a dealership or on your site depending on the brand. Travel and accommodation terms are confirmed by your CFAO contact.
faq6Q: How do I get my certificate or attestation?
faq6A: After the session is validated, the Academy issues your attestation. The learner portal will soon centralise your manufacturer certification history.
